verdicts.explanation: The paper states that the cubic Na3PS4 specimen has a room-temperature conductivity of 1.3×10−4 S cm−1, measured in this study. The room-temperature label is non-numeric, so null for the Celsius field is correct, and the annealing temperature is correctly not treated as a sintering temperature.

The paper gives 1.9×10−5 S cm−1 for tetragonal Na3PS4 in the comparison sentence, measured in this work. No measurement temperature is stated for this value, so null is correct, and the 480 °C annealing is consistent with the Materials and Methods.

The paper reports 4.1×10−6 S cm−1 for amorphous Na3PS4 prepared by ball milling in this study, with no temperature given, so null is correct. The planetary ball mill mechanochemical synthesis matches the Materials and Methods.
